title: MV YED Sideview Battler - Change Sprites mid-game

posts.author: NichnotFound
posts.body:
Hello everyone! I'm making a game in RPG Maker MV that uses the YED Sideview Battle Plugin. It's basically a plugin that changes how sideview battler sprites work in order to make it support more frames and poses.
I wanted to change the sprites mid-game but wasn't able to find any tutorial online or to find any plugin commands to do so.
I've tried using the default RPG Maker MV event to change the sprites but since the sprites are assigned to an actor based off of an notetag on the actor, it doesn't work.
Any suggestions?
